articles.title: Zelensky calls Russia's fuel imports "historical joke"
articles.summary: Zelensky stated that Ukraine has significantly disrupted Russia's fuel supply, forcing the traditionally energy-exporting nation to import fuel through Belarus and other countries.

articles.title: Zelensky reiterates call for Ukraine's NATO membership: It will make us all stronger
articles.summary: Zelensky stated that Ukraine's experience in modern warfare and defense capabilities would significantly strengthen NATO, and called for Ukraine's membership in the Alliance.
